steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: When one seeks to decipher the will of heaven, this vessel is utterly indispensable—

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: The N.F. 22 flagship communication terminal, procured just before I joined the team. It houses the foremost divination software: Ziwei Diviner app! Motion-sensing capabilities, AI-driven analysis, high-performance computation, and fully certified by the Tianyi Sect and the Eastern Continent University Institute for Spectral Phenomena!

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Simply inscribe your query, bestow it a vigorous shake like this, and the prognostications are impeccably precise. One may even request a granular analysis. I have secured the premium subscription, look!

Her fingers stab at the screen with mounting force, frustration creasing her brow. The longer you observe, the less convinced you are that she knows what she's doing. She catches your look and says casually:

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Hmm, the signal is tenuous here... No matter. It shall suffice.
When you found me earlier, didn't you say you divined my location yourself?!

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: But I did. I personally shook the device to cast the hexagram. How is that not performing the divination myself?
She shoots you a wink and gives the terminal a little flourish, smug satisfaction radiating from every inch of her.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: I'll install it on your device later. Once we get out, you may proclaim yourself a master diviner. Your patronage is assured.
